name: stralforsmcp
description: Connects Claude Desktop to a hosted Stralfors MCP server using your personal token.

server_url.description: Address of the hosted server, for example https://mcp.example.com/mcp

token.title: Personal token
token.description: Your personal token (starts with smcp_). Stored in the operating system secure store.
